Two types of human judgments serve as the golden standard. The first one is Direct Assessment (DA), which contains human scores for each translation. The second one is DArr, which consists of conclusions about one translation being better than another drawn from DA scores.
guideline: Each system summary receives 4 human judgements according to two criteria: 1) Pyramid, which reflects the level of content coverage of the summaries; and 2) Responsiveness, which measures the response level to the overall quality of linguistic and content of the summaries.
